name: Student Visa

requirements.blocker_text: This requires enrolment at a Ministry of Education or KHDA-accredited institution, sponsored by the university (or a UAE-resident parent for younger students).
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission to an accredited institution.

evidence_required.document: Admission letter from an accredited institution

outcome.duration_length: 1 year at a time, renewable on proof of continued study

sources.title: Student visa - The Official Portal of the UAE Government

notes: Male children can be sponsored by resident parents up to age 25; students over that age need their own study visa — a real, specific age rule distinct from most other countries' family-sponsorship age limits in this dataset. Part-time work permitted with a MoHRE student work permit — exact current hours-per-week figure wasn't fully confirmed at tier-1 precision during the underlying research (tier-3 sources suggested roughly 15-20 hours/week during term). Genuine and distinctive post-study pathway: outstanding graduates (high GPA, typically 3.5-3.8+, with recommendation/graduation certificate) may apply DIRECTLY for the 10-year Golden Visa within a window after graduation — a materially more generous outcome than most other countries' student-to-settlement Journey chains in this dataset, even though the Golden Visa itself still carries no citizenship path.
